scope: Source admission only; no completion, enjoyment, network or release qualification is implied.

layouts.title: Crossing Post
layouts.challenge: Use either side island as a return. Intercept the patrol beside the central gap, or intercept the optional courier between delivery stops.

layouts.title: Signal Square
layouts.challenge: Choose the inner turn or the outer return around a square island.

layouts.title: Passing Bay
layouts.challenge: Use a refuge bay to pass the circuit instead of following it.

layouts.title: Island Clock
layouts.challenge: Match a four-corner patrol from either of two island approaches.

layouts.title: Inner Shortcut
layouts.challenge: Take a narrow inner cut while the target follows the outer lane.

layouts.title: Loop Exchange
layouts.challenge: Change circuits through the center before the next patrol crossing.

layouts.title: Open Intercept
layouts.challenge: Approach the refuge target from its distant goal.

layouts.title: Shelter Fork
layouts.challenge: Choose which of two corners to cut off before leaving safety.

layouts.title: Zigzag Exit
layouts.challenge: Cross a staggered passage instead of matching every target turn.

layouts.title: Broken Ring
layouts.challenge: Use the shorter gap while the target commits to its next corner.

layouts.title: Far Corner
layouts.challenge: Turn the refuge seeker away from a long exposed chase.

layouts.title: Three-way Escape
layouts.challenge: Connect a middle return to cover three possible goal routes.

layouts.title: Warning Yard
layouts.challenge: Let the guard lock its aim before committing to the nearest return.

layouts.title: Covered Detour
layouts.challenge: Choose cover or a shorter interception across the warning lane.

layouts.title: Two Watchpoints
layouts.challenge: Approach a patrol from a protected island while avoiding guard fire.

layouts.title: Crossing Warning
layouts.challenge: Separate the patroller crossing from the guard firing window.

layouts.title: Last Safe Turn
layouts.challenge: Keep a return behind the craft while following the committed branch.

layouts.title: Courtyard Approach
layouts.challenge: Use two courtyard entrances to approach the guard and refuge target.

layouts.title: Shield Turn
layouts.challenge: Read the shield facing and approach its exposed rear.

layouts.title: Shield Flank
layouts.challenge: Use the central wall to reach the shield flank after its turn warning.

layouts.title: First Brace
layouts.challenge: Wait out the brace warning and intercept its recovery.

layouts.title: Brace Bypass
layouts.challenge: Take the bypass instead of entering the committed burst lane.

layouts.title: Mixed Post
layouts.challenge: Separate a shield approach from a brace recovery window.

layouts.title: Specialist Airfield
layouts.challenge: Combine flanking, burst evasion and an enclosure escape.

layouts.title: Pincer Yard
layouts.challenge: Approach from opposite rails. One pilot closes an escape around the divider while the partner intercepts; trade sides through the permanent upper and lower bypasses.

layouts.title: Partner Bay
layouts.challenge: One pilot closes the narrow bay while the other keeps the outside return.

layouts.title: Opposite Shores
layouts.challenge: Build different approaches toward the same patrol crossing.

layouts.title: Transfer Islands
layouts.challenge: Connect opposite islands before exchanging interception roles.

layouts.title: Crossed Bearings
layouts.challenge: Avoid converging on the same exposed lane while targets cross it.

layouts.title: Shared Compass
layouts.challenge: Choose a common return that supports two separate target approaches.

layouts.title: Refuge Pincer
layouts.challenge: One pilot approaches while the partner waits near the refuge goal.

layouts.title: Split Refuge
layouts.challenge: Divide two refuges and communicate the changed escape direction.

layouts.title: Return Triangle
layouts.challenge: Use a triangular return network to exchange pursuit and capture.

layouts.title: Meeting Cutoff
layouts.challenge: Split a rendezvous pair, then cover the surviving runner.

layouts.title: Outer Partner
layouts.challenge: Keep one pilot outside the walls while the partner crosses the inner lane.

layouts.title: Double Enclosure
layouts.challenge: Arrange two closures without competing for the same target.

layouts.title: Relay Rendezvous
layouts.challenge: Capture the two marked anchors from opposite island approaches, then enclose the exposed core. Intercept the optional pair at their meeting corridor.

layouts.title: Return Bench
layouts.challenge: Construct a shared return before pursuing the long patrol.

layouts.title: Paired Workshop
layouts.challenge: One pilot reclaims the central strip while the other intercepts.

layouts.title: Side-door Partners
layouts.challenge: Leave separate doors open until both craft have returned.

layouts.title: Shared Overpass
layouts.challenge: Use an island chain to pass the pursuit between players.

layouts.title: Workshop Exchange
layouts.challenge: Exchange sides through the new reclaimed connection.

layouts.title: Slow Bay Partners
layouts.challenge: Use the slow-material bay to make a safer partner interception.

layouts.title: Lethal Pocket
layouts.challenge: Enclose the isolated lethal material instead of crossing it.

layouts.title: Unequal Orchards
layouts.challenge: Give the longer route to one pilot while the other connects the nearer island.

layouts.title: Changing Return
layouts.challenge: Reclaim a material pocket to open the partner route.

layouts.title: Material Pincer
layouts.challenge: Choose whether to neutralize the slow bay before herding the target.

layouts.title: Garden Exchange
layouts.challenge: Combine two return networks while keeping lethal ground outside the cut.

layouts.title: Draw the Aim
layouts.challenge: One pilot draws a fixed warning while the partner approaches the guard.

layouts.title: Support Crossing
layouts.challenge: Use Interceptor support to protect a partner crossing.

layouts.title: Slow the Pursuit
layouts.challenge: Disruptor support creates a shorter interception window.

layouts.title: Cover and Return
layouts.challenge: Separate target pursuit from the guard warning lane.

layouts.title: Opposite Openings
layouts.challenge: Take different openings and share the once-only catches.

layouts.title: Warning Exchange
layouts.challenge: Swap support roles at the next safe return.

layouts.title: Paired Routes
layouts.challenge: Each pilot follows a different member of a rendezvous pair.

layouts.title: Shared Cutoff
layouts.challenge: Herd toward the partner instead of following the whole route.

layouts.title: Courtyard Partners
layouts.challenge: Use the side courts to alternate capture and pursuit.

layouts.title: Final Warning
layouts.challenge: Keep a safe partner route through the guard recovery window.

layouts.title: Rendezvous Relay
layouts.challenge: Relay the chase after the first partner target is removed.

layouts.title: Two-Pilot Airfield
layouts.challenge: Combine support, interception, shared returns and optional enclosure.

layouts.title: Refuge Bays
layouts.challenge: The refuge seeker announces its next bay. Cut across the open middle instead of following it.

layouts.title: Switchback Yard
layouts.challenge: The scarf runner signals its next exit before committing. Intercept from the opposite return.

layouts.title: Rendezvous Crossing
layouts.challenge: Two partners seek one meeting place. Each catch counts once; the survivor becomes a runner.

layouts.title: Cable Cutoff
layouts.challenge: Two offset passages turn your cable into a temporary barrier. Leave a return lane before herding the prey.

layouts.title: Return Pincer
layouts.challenge: Pair goals alternate across the long divider. In Team, use separate returns and keep both cables clear.

layouts.title: Twin Intercepts
layouts.challenge: Refuge seekers, runners and switchbacks share three courtyards. Choose a different approach for each intention.

layouts.title: Shield Window
layouts.challenge: Specialist: the marked shield front is fatal. Catch from the side or rear; a warned turn keeps its old facing until complete.

layouts.title: Brace Break
layouts.challenge: Specialist: warning and burst are protected. Catch during the long recovery, when the armor visibly opens.

layouts.title: Shutter Flank
layouts.challenge: The center shortcut opens beside the shield. Take the permanent outer return when either danger blocks the approach.

layouts.title: Frozen Opening
layouts.challenge: Pulse freezes the current armor state, not just movement. Collect it during recovery to extend the safe catch window.

layouts.title: Supply Flanks
layouts.challenge: Refuge goals and shield flanks compete with supply detours. Reel frees space, but cannot undo a collision.

layouts.title: Living Airfield
layouts.challenge: Two timed crossings link specialist and ordinary prey. Read each silhouette, choose a safe return, then commit.

layouts.title: Low Pass Depot
layouts.challenge: Meet a slow perimeter patrol at a low crate crossing. Cut across the depot instead of following the loop.

layouts.title: Split Yard Return
layouts.challenge: Two independent patrol loops flank a divider. Return around its end or rise over it to change sides.

layouts.title: Crossing Arrivals
layouts.challenge: Long and short patrol rectangles share two crossings. Choose an arrival to intercept rather than chase the closest body.

layouts.title: Shelter Arc
layouts.challenge: A horseshoe route passes through a broad sheltered lane. Wait at its open return or fly over the low shelter.

layouts.title: Freight Slalom
layouts.challenge: Patrols weave through three long aisles. Cross over a low freight row to gain an interception without threading every turn.

layouts.title: Forked Depot
layouts.challenge: Two loops use a shared approach but different return distances. Alternate wings to leave your growing echo behind.

layouts.title: Low Roof Window
layouts.challenge: A broad canopy leaves a low approach underneath and an open aerial bypass. Settle your altitude before the patrol arrives.

layouts.title: Roofline Exchange
layouts.challenge: Patrols occupy two separate raised platforms. Gain height in the open centre, then descend toward each marked torso.

layouts.title: Return Slot
layouts.challenge: A long wall has one wide ground-level slot. Intercept there or spend height to take the outer return.

layouts.title: Staggered Roofs
layouts.challenge: A perimeter patrol surrounds three unequal roofs. Choose the low crossing or a wider, flatter approach.

layouts.title: Window Chain
layouts.challenge: Two low canopies interrupt opposite patrol straights. Clear each approach before committing and keep the echo out of your return.

layouts.title: Three-yard Finale
layouts.challenge: Three courtyards offer low passages and aerial shortcuts. Plan a sweep that leaves space for eight catches and a long echo.
